test.create_query: CREATE TABLE laion (id UInt32, vector Array(BFloat16) CODEC(NONE)) ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE laion_queries (n UInt8, id UInt32, qv Array(BFloat16)) ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE laion_exact (v String, n UInt8, ids Array(UInt32)) ORDER BY (v, n)
CREATE TABLE laion_ann (v String, n UInt8, ids Array(UInt32)) ORDER BY (v, n)
CREATE TABLE laion_build (id UInt32, vector Array(BFloat16) CODEC(NONE)) ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO laion SELECT id, vector FROM s3('https://clickhouse-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/laion-5b/laion5b_100m_part_1_of_10.parquet', NOSIGN, Parquet) LIMIT 1000000 SETTINGS input_format_parquet_preserve_order = 1, max_insert_threads = 16
ALTER TABLE laion MODIFY SETTING lock_acquire_timeout_for_background_operations = 600
OPTIMIZE TABLE laion FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 1000000 OR sum(id) != 2349976459807 OR countIf(length(vector) != 768) != 0) FROM laion
SELECT throwIf(count() != 1) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'laion' AND active
ALTER TABLE laion ADD INDEX vi vector TYPE vector_similarity('hnsw', 'cosineDistance', 768, 'bf16', 16, 128)
ALTER TABLE laion MATERIALIZE INDEX vi SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
INSERT INTO laion_build SELECT id, vector FROM laion ORDER BY id LIMIT 100000
OPTIMIZE TABLE laion_build FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 100000) FROM laion_build
ALTER TABLE laion_build ADD INDEX vi vector TYPE vector_similarity('hnsw', 'cosineDistance', 768, 'bf16', 16, 128)
ALTER TABLE laion_build CLEAR INDEX vi, MATERIALIZE INDEX vi SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
INSERT INTO laion_queries SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY cityHash64(id)) AS n, id, vector FROM laion ORDER BY cityHash64(id) LIMIT 60

INSERT INTO laion_exact SELECT 'all', q.n, arrayMap(x -> x.2, groupArraySorted(100)((cosineDistance(t.vector, q.qv), t.id))) FROM laion AS t CROSS JOIN laion_queries AS q GROUP BY q.n SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0

INSERT INTO laion_exact SELECT 'pre', q.n, arrayMap(x -> x.2, groupArraySorted(10)((cosineDistance(t.vector, q.qv), t.id))) FROM laion AS t CROSS JOIN laion_queries AS q WHERE t.id < 413533 GROUP BY q.n SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0

INSERT INTO laion_exact SELECT 'build', q.n, arrayMap(x -> x.2, groupArraySorted(10)((cosineDistance(t.vector, q.qv), t.id))) FROM laion_build AS t CROSS JOIN laion_queries AS q GROUP BY q.n SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'k10', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 0, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'k100', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 100) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 0, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'ef1024', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 100) SETTINGS hnsw_candidate_list_size_for_search = 1024, vector_search_with_rescoring = 0, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'rescoring', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 100) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 1, vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 4, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'post', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion WHERE id % 2 = 0 ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_filter_strategy = 'postfilter', vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 4, vector_search_with_rescoring = 0, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'pre', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion WHERE id < 413533 ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_filter_strategy = 'prefilter', vector_search_with_rescoring = 0

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'pk50', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion WHERE id < 1870119 ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_filter_strategy = 'postfilter', vector_search_index_fetch_multiplier = 4, vector_search_with_rescoring = 0

INSERT INTO laion_ann SELECT 'build', {n}, groupArray(id) FROM (WITH (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {n}) AS q SELECT id FROM laion_build ORDER BY cosineDistance(vector, q) LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 0, log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index'
SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS

SELECT throwIf(count() != 360 OR min(ProfileEvents['USearchSearchCount']) = 0) FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Insert' AND log_comment = 'vector_index_laion.index' AND event_time >= (SELECT metadata_modification_time FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'default' AND name = 'laion_ann')

SELECT throwIf(groupArray(v) != ['build', 'ef1024', 'k10', 'k100', 'pk50', 'post', 'pre', 'rescoring'] OR min(c) != 60 OR max(bad) != 0 OR min(recall - multiIf(v = 'pre', 0.99, v IN ('post', 'pk50'), 0.9, 0.95)) < 0) FROM ( SELECT v, count() AS c, countIf(length(ids) != if(v IN ('k100', 'ef1024', 'rescoring'), 100, 10) OR length(truth) != length(ids)) AS bad, avg(length(arrayIntersect(ids, truth)) / length(ids)) AS recall FROM ( SELECT a.v AS v, a.ids AS ids, multiIf( v IN ('pre', 'build'), e.ids, v = 'post', arraySlice(arrayFilter(x -> x % 2 = 0, e.ids), 1, 10), v = 'pk50', arraySlice(arrayFilter(x -> x < 1870119, e.ids), 1, 10), arraySlice(e.ids, 1, length(a.ids))) AS truth FROM laion_ann AS a INNER JOIN laion_exact AS e ON e.v = if(a.v IN ('pre', 'build'), a.v, 'all') AND e.n = a.n) GROUP BY v ORDER BY v)

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray(d)) != (SELECT groupArraySorted(10)(cosineDistance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {exact}))) FROM laion)) FROM (SELECT id, cosineDistance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = {exact})) AS d FROM laion ORDER BY d LIMIT 10) SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = 0, vector_search_with_rescoring = 0

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray(d)) != (SELECT groupArraySorted(2000)(cosineDistance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = 7))) FROM laion)) FROM (SELECT id, cosineDistance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = 7)) AS d FROM laion ORDER BY d LIMIT 2000) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 0

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray(d)) != (SELECT groupArraySorted(10)(L2Distance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = 8))) FROM laion)) FROM (SELECT id, L2Distance(vector, (SELECT qv FROM laion_queries WHERE n = 8)) AS d FROM laion ORDER BY d LIMIT 10) SETTINGS vector_search_with_rescoring = 0
